transcript: Robot: Where are you going? Man: I go to home. Robot: You mean, I am going home. Man: Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry. Robot: I am in a hurry is the correct way. Man: Okay, I am in a hurry. रुको, तुम इंग्लिश इतनी आसानी से सिखा रही हो, तुम हो कौन? [Wait, you are teaching English so easily, who are you?] Robot: मैं इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप की एआई टीचर हूँ, जो तुम्हें अपनी इंग्लिश इम्प्रूव और फ्लूएंट करने में मदद करेगी। [I am the AI teacher of the English Seekho app, who will help you improve and become fluent in your English.] Man: ओके, बट हर नो मनीस। [Okay, but her no moneys.] Robot: You mean, I have no money. But don't worry, सिर्फ एक रुपये में इसका ट्रायल लेकर देखो। और सिर्फ 15 दिन रेगुलर प्रैक्टिस करो, और तुम्हें अपने कॉन्फिडेंस में फर्क नजर आएगा। एक्सपर्ट्स से सीखो, मेरे साथ प्रैक्टिस करो। कभी मजाक नहीं उड़ाऊंगी। 24 घंटे अवेलेबल, जब मन करे। [You mean, I have no money. But don't worry, take its trial for just 1 rupee. And practice regularly for just 15 days, and you will see a difference in your confidence. Learn from experts, practice with me. I will never make fun of you. Available 24 hours, whenever you feel like.] Man: सच में? मैं अभी इंस्टॉल करता हूँ इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। [Really? I will install the English Seekho app right now.] Voiceover: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho. INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text in Hindi/Hinglish regarding government affiliation and results]
summary: An AI robot teacher corrects a man's broken English in a split-screen format set on the moon. The robot promotes the English Seekho app, highlighting a 1-rupee trial and 24/7 practice availability. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
